rule: Each experiment must say what is accepted on TN12, what is script-enforced, what is wallet-policy, and what is only reducer/indexer state.

experiments.title: Treasury Wars
experiments.proofTarget: accepted recurring-vault spend, continuation state, blocked over-cap attempt
experiments.whyItMatters: Turns the active recurring cap rail into a simple strategy loop: each player has money, a cap window, allowed destinations, and relocked state.
experiments.websitePitch: Spend under your cap, relock the treasury, and block the move that tries to drain too much.
nextBuildSteps: Fetch the funded input covenant_id through RPC/data verbosity.
Re-run the live-spend preflight until it is ready for guarded submit.
Spend the funded RecurringTreasuryVault output on TN12 only through the Rust route.
Record the new state and relocked change output.
Turn the over-cap negative map into the opponent's blocked move.
experiments.hardBoundary: The ownerSig covenant path is locally proven and the Rust route preserves covenant binding, but script-enforced recurring caps require an accepted spend from the funded contract output.

experiments.title: Covenant Heist
experiments.proofTarget: negative candidate suite with one or more accepted defenses
experiments.whyItMatters: Makes the adversarial side visible. The game is a vault attack/defense loop where the interesting evidence is what cannot be spent.
experiments.websitePitch: Try the wrong signer, wrong destination, stale window, over-cap spend, or missing relock. The vault should refuse the bad path.
nextBuildSteps: Render each negative as a heist attempt.
Attach the exact rule that blocks it.
Promote rows only when the candidate maps to a local reject or TN12 rejected spend attempt.
experiments.hardBoundary: Do not fake rejection evidence. Candidate rows must stay candidates until a builder or node rejects a concrete spend.

experiments.title: Blitz Mux Arena
experiments.proofTarget: hub routes to worker, worker returns to hub, timeout escape path
experiments.whyItMatters: Smallest source-faithful demo of the chess architecture without building full chess. It makes fast multi-transaction state transitions feel natural.
experiments.websitePitch: A hub sends the turn to one worker contract. The worker returns valid state before the clock runs out.
nextBuildSteps: Decide whether this stays as a local mux proof or gets a funded TN12 output.
If funded, build a guarded live-spend preflight that preserves the family covenant_id.
Extend only after one funded route and worker return are accepted.
Keep timeout evidence attached before adding challenge/settlement rows.
experiments.hardBoundary: Compiled and locally proven only. It is not an accepted TN12 mux/worker spend yet.

experiments.title: Coordination League
experiments.proofTarget: threshold commitments, batch release/refund, replayed settlement rows
experiments.whyItMatters: Directly maps the Stag Hunt talk into repo evidence: commit only when enough compatible commitments also exist.
experiments.websitePitch: Players pledge to a group objective. If enough compatible pledges appear, the group path opens; otherwise refund stays explicit.
nextBuildSteps: Pick one transparent pack.
Attach pledge outputs and release/refund status.
Keep privacy and pooled custody out of scope.
experiments.hardBoundary: Coordination receipts are not private commitments and not pooled custody.

experiments.title: Covenant-Owned Asset Duel
experiments.proofTarget: asset UTXO owned by a covenant input through sibling-input authorization
experiments.whyItMatters: Demonstrates ICC: one covenant does not execute the other, but can accept its sibling input as authority.
experiments.websitePitch: A game contract owns an asset. Moving the asset requires the game covenant input in the same transaction.
nextBuildSteps: Pick whether this stays as a local ICC proof or gets a funded TN12 output.
If funded, build a guarded submit preflight with the same covenant_id rule.
Keep negative cases attached: missing sibling, wrong witness, wrong sibling covenant_id.
experiments.hardBoundary: Compiled and locally proven only. It is not an accepted TN12 asset spend yet.

experiments.title: Scheduler Duel
experiments.proofTarget: accepted scheduler intents, eligible trigger, executor receipt, blocked stale action
experiments.whyItMatters: Uses current scheduler evidence to show conditional actions without pretending they are autonomous custody.
experiments.covenantPattern: based-app scheduler with covenant settlement target
experiments.websitePitch: Write a conditional move. Executors compete to fire it only when the replayed state says it is eligible.
nextBuildSteps: Choose two trigger templates.
Bind one trigger to accepted covenant evidence.
Show stale or duplicate execution blocked by replay.
experiments.hardBoundary: Executor receipts are replay evidence, not proof of autonomous on-chain execution.
